snippet.title: Sparrow Warfare Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Our new game is a mahjong-inspired deckbuilder FULL OF BIRDS! Take a look at our initial gameplay trailer, and if you like the look of our wildtile action, wishlist on Steam and join us for playtesting!
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473440/Sparrow_Warfare/
